notes.title: Exciting Update: Introducing Chameleon Dice
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
[list]
[*]The "Chameleon" dice, which can be included in your deck as is or merged with other dice.
[*]Two new challenges, featuring the "Chameleon" dice.
[*]Minor enhancements to the game's finale and adjustments to the ascensions.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Several issues with the "Insurance" card have been resolved.
[*]Improved Spanish and Portuguese localizations.
[*]Corrected the functionality of the upgraded "Maximum" and "Jab" cards.
[*]Opening the "Cleanup" card through the "On Distance" card.
[*]Various visual bugs have also been fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Perfect Dice is coming out in two weeks!
notes.content:
[b]You will be expected to: [/b]
[list]
[*] Over 50 unique cards
[*] More than 10 dice, which can be combined with each other
[*] Many enemies, in each of which you will have to find an original approach.
[*] Dozens of possible unlikeable strategies
[*] One main boss, the fight with which will determine whether you are worthy of owning the Perfect Cube or not. 
[/list]

notes.title: Big update of Demo
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Visualization of the chances of a successful dice roll[/b]. Now, when hovering over each dice, you will see the probability of that dice roll being successful. The best part is that the probability calculations are dynamic: each situation is evaluated separately.

[*] [b]New trial mode[/b]. Especially enjoyable for puzzle or chess enthusiasts. In this mode, the player must find the only possible course of action in which they will have a 100% chance of winning. If the chance is lower, the player will inevitably lose. The trial mode is designed to show players how randomness can sometimes be manipulated, essentially reducing it to nothing.

[*] [b]Change in card movement mechanics[/b]. From now on, no more restrictions; move the cards as many times as you want per turn. Moreover, it has become much more convenient to do so. In addition to the tablet buttons, you can now use the mouse wheel or keyboard buttons.

[*] [b]Starting bonus[/b]. Now, at the beginning of each race, you can choose one of two consumables that will help you in subsequent battles and increase your chances of completing the game.
[/list]
